specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: The AMS has 4 filament slots, each filament slot has its own motor and gears to actively push the filament forward or wind it back to the spool.
specs.note: The function introduction agrees ("There are four feeders on the AMS, which pull the filament into the AMS."). The store page states 4 slots only in marketing prose ("Each Bambu Lab AMS is composed of 4 filament slots"); no conflict.

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: A1 Series Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
specs.quote: Supports up to 4 AMS units (AMS, AMS 2 Pro, or AMS HT) connected at the same time.
specs.note: The models can be mixed in any combination (through the A Series AMS Hub). Agrees with the store variant note "A1 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS HT, AMS, AMS 2 Pro)."

specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: It allows the user to connect four AMS units, which in turn can supply 16 different filament spools to the printer.
specs.note: Sentence about the AMS Hub in the X1 manual's AMS introduction. The connection guide's X1/P1 section says "4 units in total". Agrees with the store variant note "X1/P1 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS HT, AMS, AMS 2 Pro)."

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: A2L Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
specs.quote: Supports up to 4 AMS units and 1 AMS lite simultaneously
specs.note: The wiki section names the A2L; the store's "A2 Series" variant notes speak of the "A2L series printer" and agree ("can connect up to 4 AMS units(including AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT) and 1 AMS lite").

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
specs.quote: P2S printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 4 AMS HT units.
specs.note: Store variant prose, so unverified. The wiki P2S section counts only AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT ("up to 4 AMS 2 Pro and 4 AMS HT units simultaneously") and does not name the AMS (1st gen).

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
specs.quote: H2 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 8 AMS HT units.
specs.note: Store variant prose, so unverified. The wiki H2 section counts only AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT ("Supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro units and 8 AMS HT units") and does not name the AMS (1st gen).

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
specs.quote: H2 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units(including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 8 AMS HT units .
specs.note: Store variant prose, so unverified. The wiki H2 section counts only AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT and does not name the AMS (1st gen).

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
specs.quote: X2D series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units(including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 8 AMS HT units.
specs.note: Store variant prose, so unverified. The wiki X2D section counts only AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT ("Supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro and 8 AMS HT units simultaneously") and does not name the AMS (1st gen).

specs.value: Up to 16 filaments with 4 AMS units connected through the AMS Hub
specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: It allows the user to connect four AMS units, which in turn can supply 16 different filament spools to the printer.
specs.note: Agrees with the store's marketing heading "Support Up to 16 Colors" (prose, not used as proof).

specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: when using AMS, please note that the ambient temperature must be maintained at 10-30 ℃ and the humidity must be less than 85%.
specs.note: The same sentence also sets ambient humidity below 85 %; the registry has no ambient-humidity key for the ams type, so it is kept only in this quote. The store page states no operating temperature.

specs.source_title: AMS main functions and workflow introduction | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: AMS feeding system introduction › Filament hub
specs.quote: The filament Hub is located at the rear of the AMS and consists of four sensors, an odometer, and a motor.
specs.note: Same section: "The odometer is used to determine whether the filament has been sent out of the AMS, and can also be used to calculate the length of the filament sent out." The X1 AMS introduction calls it "one magnetic rotary encoder".

specs.source_title: AMS main functions and workflow introduction | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: The main functions of AMS › Filament run-out detection and auto-refill function
specs.quote: When you use AMS printing, it still has the filament run-out detection function
specs.note: Agrees with the store feature bullet "Filament Runout & Winding Detection".

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
specs.quote: When the filament at the toolhead encounters resistance, it may be that the filament is tangled or the spool is stuck, AMS can detect it immediately and suspend printing to avoid air printing.
specs.note: Marketing section, so unverified. The wiki connection guide attributes tangle detection to the filament buffer ("adjusting the feeding speed and detecting filament tangles"); the buffer is a separate part on X1/P1 and P2S and built into H2 printers.

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: H2 Series AMS Connection Guide › Cable Connection
specs.quote: Each AMS has two 6-pin ports on the back, allowing you to daisy-chain multiple AMS units.
specs.note: The page defines "AMS" as the AMS (first generation), AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT collectively; the sentence repeats in the X2D and P2S sections. The same page notes "The step height of the cable provided with the AMS is 1.1 mm". Region-free (not a US 110 V table).
